execution_status: The current aal train command does not consume config files; these values document an implementation-aligned reference run.

observation_encoder.current_agent_spec: HybridAgent derives max_orders from the reset scenario and cannot retain one network across incompatible vector or option sizes.

options.labels: one option per scenario order followed by charge and wait
options.order_execution: pickup and dropoff through blockage-aware A-star
options.charge_execution: route to a reachable charger then charge
options.fallback: none; infeasible low-level routes emit wait

training.note: One semi-MDP update occurs when an active option completes, fails, or reaches episode termination.

reward_note: stranded_cost is declared by RewardScheme but is not applied by WarehouseEnvironment v0.1.

artifacts.state_format: JSON-compatible HybridAgent.state_dict with one option network
artifacts.optimizer_state: none; plain SGD has no accumulated optimizer state
